# Grafana v13.2.2

> Documentation generated from the latest stable release of [grafana/grafana](https://github.com/grafana/grafana) and pinned to immutable source commit `3db12332b66497c31f8ad2a5fb0eb0fe0ca05a7e`.

- [Full documentation](llms-full.txt): Complete normalized corpus for Grafana v13.2.2.
- [Provenance manifest](manifest.json): Release, commit, document count, and generation notes.
- Page order, sections, and cross-references follow the Hugo weights of docs/sources at the release tag, resolved against https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/v13.2/.
- Shared fragments referenced by `docs/shared` and `shared-snippet` are inlined into the pages that render them and are not published separately.
- Hugo shortcodes are expanded to plain Markdown; version placeholders are replaced with the pinned release version.
- Content that only exists as a website widget is omitted: `docs/ignore` blocks, the `docs/whats-new` release feed, and shared fragments owned by other Grafana products.

## About Grafana

- [About Grafana](pages/introduction/index.md): Grafana open source software enables you to query, visualize, alert on, and explore your metrics, logs, and traces wherever they are stored. Grafana OSS provides you with tools to turn your time-series database (TSDB) d… (12291 bytes)
- [Grafana Enterprise](pages/introduction/grafana-enterprise.md): Grafana Enterprise is a commercial edition of Grafana that includes additional features not found in the open source version. (9569 bytes)
- [Grafana Cloud](pages/introduction/grafana-cloud.md): Grafana Cloud is a highly available, fast, fully-managed OpenSaaS logging and metrics platform. It is everything you love about Grafana, hosted by Grafana Labs. (281 bytes)

## Grafana Alerting

(2836 bytes)
